title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I heard you guys are close to a deal with Fiers
Like, more close than just a rumor. One year
Close but not yet on one year
Ok, so what’s the timeline. Agreement? Physical?
You know that is a touchy subject
Not for use, I’m just trying to know how to report it.
Like, can I put “close” out there, is it pending a physical? Or do you want me to wait on it
